# Target
Task T9 - Pin blocker detail. Feature `structured-logging-pin-diagnostics`, revision `r8-pin-diagnostics`. Ticket 09.

Read first, bounded: `.scratch/structured-logging/spec.md` section 2 (R21, R8), section 4 (AD18), section 5 (AC09-1..AC09-8), section 6 T9; rulings 2-5 and 13; `.scratch/structured-logging/issues/09-*.md`.

# Change
1. `internal/service/reload.go`: the pin identity at the existing wrap site (defect site reload.go:562-564) is text-only. Carry structured pin identity ALONGSIDE the existing wrap - do not replace the wrap text.
2. `internal/service/refresh.go`: collect every pin blocker in the pass, not just the first.
3. `internal/service/refresh.go` / `internal/observe/log.go`: emit `pin_blocker_detail` per pin with source location (`property_path`, line, column equivalent) and the structured pin identity; `internal/observe/envelope.go`: add the `pin_blocker_detail` AD20 keys.
4. Every field ends up in the record - no raw error text anywhere (R8).

# Test first
Author `internal/service/pin_blocker_test.go` first: with several unresolved pins, ALL pins are reported with source locations. Run it, capture the failing output as RED evidence - today only the first, text-only pin is described.

# Verify
`go test ./internal/service -run 'Pin|Blocker|Refresh'`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l` over the changed files.

# Receipt
Write `.omp/artifacts/receipt_T9.json` with task_id T9, status, and evidence entries carrying command and exitCode.

# Constraints
- Only the files in this dispatch's effects. No other production files.
- At most 42 read/search operations before the first edit; if exceeded, stop and report stalled.
- No external SDK/vendor research.
- No raw error text in any field (R8).
- Do not change the r7 configuration-diagnostic renderer or its tests.
